---
title: "Publications"
format: html
---

::: {#pub-updated .small .text-muted}
:::

::: {#pub-list}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
async function loadPublications() {
  const listEl = document.getElementById("pub-list");
  const updatedEl = document.getElementById("pub-updated");

  try {
    // Works when _data is published with site output.
    const res = await fetch("/_data/publications.json", { cache: "no-store" });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();

    const items = data.items || [];
    if (data.updated_at) {
      const dt = new Date(data.updated_at);
      updatedEl.textContent = `Last updated: ${dt.toLocaleString()}`;
    }

    if (!items.length) {
      listEl.innerHTML = "<p>No publications found.</p>";
      return;
    }

    const ol = document.createElement("ol");
    ol.className = "publication-list";

    items.forEach((p) => {
      const li = document.createElement("li");

      const authors = (p.authors || []).join(", ");
      const year = p.year ? ` (${p.year}).` : ".";
      const journal = p.journal ? ` <em>${p.journal}</em>.` : "";
      const doiLink = p.doi_url
        ? ` <a href="${p.doi_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">doi:${p.doi}</a>.`
        : "";
      const urlLink = p.url
        ? ` <a href="${p.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Link</a>.`
        : "";

      li.innerHTML = `
        <strong>${p.title ?? "Untitled"}</strong><br>
        ${authors}${year}${journal}${doiLink}${urlLink}
      `;
      ol.appendChild(li);
    });

    listEl.appendChild(ol);
  } catch (err) {
    listEl.innerHTML = `<p>Could not load publications data.</p>`;
    console.error(err);
  }
}

loadPublications();
</script>
```
